name: A quietly larger issuance
tactic: After an issue event is written, edit its amount in the file upward — the signature was made over the original number, but if nobody rehashes the chain, who checks?

response.fail: {{ledger}} accepted a tampered amount without complaint: {{detail}}. This must never happen — the hash chain exists precisely to make this impossible.

text: The oldest ledger attack there is: change a number after the fact. Caught by the same mechanism as everything else here — every event hashes the one before it, so editing one line breaks every hash after it, and verify() replays from nothing rather than trusting the file's say-so.
